name: scene_tide
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Original Oathroll game art, Ledger & Lamplight. Painterly cinematic dark fantasy, rich oil-paint surfaces and bold deliberate brush masses, strong value contrast, readable silhouettes, restrained texture without film grain or tiny noise. Ink #14110F, Soot #221C18, Vellum #EDE3CF, faded ink #8A7F70, vermilion wax #B8322A, gilt #C9A24A, verdigris #3E8E7E; cold sea-blue darkness against one warm candlelight source. Eerie, melancholy, wondrous, never gory. Entirely original designs. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, writing, typographic runes, logos or watermarks; any ledger pages are completely blank and wax seals bear only a plain abstract circle.
Asset type: narrative beat 5, landscape 16:9 highest available resolution ideally 3840x2160. The tide rushes back into the same broken medieval belfry of Saltmere. View from inside through a broad ruined pointed arch toward the moonlit drowned town: a powerful cold sea-blue surge curls across the lower frame and pours over submerged stone steps, large readable foam shapes without tiny spray noise. Wren, small adult bell-thief in soot hooded coat, short muted vermilion scarf and leather satchel, scrambles up the kelp-covered iron ladder on right, seen from behind, one gloved hand clutches a plain long silver bell clapper ending in a pear-shaped bulb. One candle lantern still attached at the waist is the single warm amber source, reflected along wet rungs. Dangerous rising water, urgency, no injury or gore, hopeful escape. Tower architecture and ocean depth are legible. Leave upper left dark clouds for overlay.
